description: Text layer of an uploaded two-page lease renewal letter (synthetic), dated Fri Oct 16, 2026, Chicago. Pages are joined exactly as lib/capture/document.ts joinPages() does (a blank line between pages) and meta.page_offsets gives each page's start, so evidence pages are checked (page 1: renewal, page 2: parking permit). 'no later than' is a deadline idiom around a full date. The furnace inspection carries a correct weekday + month-day and says no action is needed.
